messages.full_text:
👉🏾👉🏾👉🏾 The #Five #Pillar #Mysteries

Dear and respected members who follow the orthodox education and spiritual service that we convey on the John's Repentance page;  Today,  we hereby sent you the following basic religion lesson which we prepared in simple way of discription so that everybody can easily understand it; Hence, we entrust you to read and learn from it.

In Orthodoxy, the Five Pillars of Mysteries are called absolute dogmas. Apostle St. Paul explained that there are five pillars of truth and doctrine of salvation in the church. 1 Cor 14:19

The five pillar mysteries are: -

1. Mystery of Trinity: This is where we learn the unity and trinity of the Holy Trinity. Holy Trinity a special and unique form of Trinity and it means three in One, One in three. 

2. Mystery of Incarnation: This is where we learn the mystery of God becoming human. (God came down to us from the heavens and saved us, he became a man and was born from Mary, this mystery is the mystery of God becoming a man.)

3. Mystery of Baptism: This is where we learn about the baptism of our Lord Jesus Christ and the mystery of being reborn from God through baptism. Therefore, the sacrement of baptism in which we are born of water and the Spirit and receive the sonship of God is called the second birth. In Ephesians chapter four, it is written that baptism is one.

4. Mystery of Eucharistic: It is where we learn about the fact that the Holy Body of Jesus Christ and His Precious Blood are eternal life. Drink my blood and eat my flesh, our Lord Jesus Christ told us in his gospel that we must all receive the Holy Communion in order to have eternal life.

5. The Mystery of Resurrection (Eternal Life): This is where we learn about the second coming (the end of the world) and the resurrection of the dead. We believe in the resurrection of the dead, that when our Lord Jesus Christ comes, we will rise from the dead on the last day.

In the below paragraphs, we will take a closer look to briefly explain about  each of the Five Pillars Mysteries፦

1. Mystery of Trinity

The Mystery of Trinity is the first among the five pillars of mysteries at our Orthodox Church. Because it is the most fundamental of all Christian dogmas; and it is the basis for our salvation.  

It is impossible to comprehend the fundamental teachings of the Holy Bible in the absence of a clear understanding about the Mystery of Holy Trinity. This mystery is part and parcel of each and every spiritual life and service.

The word is derived from a Geez word and it means threeness. This concerns the unity and trinity of the living God. God is one God. In unity, His name is called Creator, Lord, God, etc. In trinity, the name is called the Holy Trinity.

(Part 2, to be continued)👇

text: We also believe in three Persons – the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

text:
(Psalm 32:1, 1 John 5:7, Matthew 28, 19)  The Father is described as the Heart  . The Son is also called the Son of God, His ‘Word’, and 'God with us'. The Holy Spirit is called the ‘life’, or ‘breath’ of God, and God within us. But the three are one. As the Apostle Paul stated it clearly “There is no other God but one” (1 Corinthians 8:4).

text: The Father  begets the Son; and gives forth the Holy Spirit. He is the unbegotten and never proceeds/comes out.  The Son's deed is to be born; begotten from God the father. text.text: the Father has a perfect person, a perfect appearance, a perfect form; The Son has a perfect person, a perfect appearance, a perfect form; The Holy Spirit has a perfect person and a perfect appearance.

text: They are three real, concrete and absolutely distinct persons

text.text: .  Father, Son and Holy Spirit are three entirely distinct modes of existence. The three are not parts of the same person, nor three ways of manifestation to the world. They are undivided, inseparable, and Perfectly united, and God is their name of unity.

text:
"Let us make man according to our likeness" Gen 1:26 "Adam became like one of us" Gen 3:22 is the expression of the physical God in addition to the mystery of the flesh. God is not a physical entity, but an abstract and spiritual entity.

So, trinity is Three in one and One in Three. This doesn't mean three persons who together make one God.

text.text: Trinity is not three Gods joined together. Trinity is not three properties of God. Our forefathers have stated this as “The Father is God, the Son is God, the Holy Spirit is God. They are called one God but not three Gods.”

text:
(Apostolic Athanasius Faith of the Fathers Ch. 24 Part 4 Verse 4). 
Because, although we say the Trinity are three in name, in deed and in person; the three are one in essence, in divinity, in existence and in will; we do not mean three Gods but one God. While the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit exist in their own perfect person, they are one in existence ”  (Abulidis, Faith of the Fathers, Ch. 40 Verse 4:6). St Gregory stated it as “When I say God, I mean Father, Son and Holy Spirit.”  There is no confusion of names and deed in the Trinity. The Holy Trinity thinks with the heart of the Father and speaks with the words of the Son, and by the breath of the Holy Spirit they live. 
 
In the time of the apostles, the Lord said  " baptize them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit." Question: Someone asked the question can the Holy Body be given without the precious blood? Must Holy Communion happen after Holy Baptism?
 
✍️Answer #1:

text:
The first question is can the Holy Body be given without the precious blood? Our questioner; First of all, we must understand that we are commanded to receive His Holy Body and His Precious Blood. Our Lord our God Jesus Christ, crucified on the cross, broke his holy body, shed his precious blood, he told us that whoever ate my body and drank my blood has eternal life. He told us that this is my flesh and blood that will be shed for the welfare of the world. Therefore, the creator spoke about both his holy body and his precious blood.

Therefore, we cannot say that if the flesh is present, the blood is not needed, because that is not the teaching we have received from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. We do it God's way. Eat my flesh, we will eat his flesh; Drink my blood, we will drink his blood. We do what we are exactly told to do. When we look at John 6:55-56, "For my flesh is true food and my blood is true drink. He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, abideth in me, and I in him." He said. Therefore, baptism of rebirth, is from Water & Spirit; and this childhood baptism is the door and the entrance to all mysteries, and it is mandatory. For those who are baptized, they need to receive the Holy Body and the Precious Blood; It means that they will receive Holy Communion for the first time on that same day. Therefore, from that moment on, any child of God must not stop receiving Christ's holy body and precious blood in order to live as a man before Him or to continue being a child of God. This is a never ending system.

There are sacrements that are repeated and not repeated; Childhood baptism is never repeated. Of course, there are many types of baptism. There is the baptism of repentance, baptism of Keder, baptism of healing and these types of baptism are repeated; But the childhood baptism, which we have been explaining above, is only one and will never be repeated. As we are born from our parents only once, we get born from Holy spirit and water (through baptism) only once.  “He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned.” Mark 16:16 “Unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.”  

There are Mysteries to be repeated and not to be repeated. Mystery of Repentance and Mystry of eucharist are releated.  So, we repent before we receive Holy Communion. It is impossible to receive his holy body and precious blood without being baptized upon childhood baptism from the Water and Spirt. So, there are also other sacrements, like the sacrement of confirmation, of pennance, of Holy Orders (ordination), of Matrimony, and of unction of the sick (anointing the sick). 👉🏾👉🏾👉🏾 The Five #Pillar #Mysteries

2. Mystery of Incarnation

(Part 5)

The next major pillar, among the 5 pillar mysteries is called  'Mystery of Incarnation'. Mystery of Incarnation  basically defines the religious and spiritual identity of Orthodox Christianity. Through incarnation, mysteries of the kingdom of God were revealed to human beings. It’s on the basis of this mystery that our apostolic orthodox church got the prefix in its name “Tewahedo”. Tewahedo is a Geez word which represents the inseparable unity between Divinity and humanity in the person of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

This is a teaching about the revelation of God to human beings. This is the Word, one part of the Holy Trinity who never man. “No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.” (John 1:18) His coming is basically to save the world, to reveal his love, a religion where we declare that he is a perfect man. It reveals the reality of redemption of Adam's sin, about how God became Man. He loved mankind and was born of the Holy Virgin Mary to save mankind whose grace was rejected and was about to be crushed by the feet of demons. The other reason He chose to become Human is to reveal his love to mankind. He loved man to the extent of being crucified on the cross.  (Hos 14:4 John 3:16 1John 4:19 Romans 5:8 Ephe 2:4). "When the end of the age came, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law." As Galatians 4:4 says. The other  reason of His being human is to become an ultimate role model for human beings, (Gen 3:12 4:8 13:13 Ps 61:4 Matt 11:29 2Peter 2:21)., God taught us everything we need to do to become his children.  

We believe that God the Son (Jesus Christ) has two births.  In the pre world, God the Son, has been begotten from God the Father without a mother. In the latter days, through incarnation, He was born from the Holy Virgin Mary with Virginal conception and without a human fatherhood. Then after, the incarnated God the Son, was named Jesus (savior), Christ (the anointed one or Messiah.), Emmanuel (God is with us) and there are other names too, among them Orthodox Christians usually call Him 'Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ' (Medicine of the world). (Galatians 4:4 Isa 7:14 Gen 3:15 18:13 12:8 Ps 107:20).
 
In the mystery of the flesh, the divinity, which is invisible in its nature, was manifested by the incarnation of the flesh. The intangible was grasped, beaten, the immortal died in the flesh, the unhungry hungered and thirsted, the draft smote. The flesh was made alive by the divinity, the flesh to which the ages are counted, and the divinity to whom the ages are not counted (was before all ages), was called the first. Adam became one of us.” According to Genesis 3:22, the first deity was reckoned at the time of his incarnation, the son of God the Father became the son of the Virgin Mary. The Son of a Virgin was called the Son of God the Father.  

Based on Orthodox Tewahdo teaching, incarnation is from two Persons to one Person; and from two natures to one united nature. It means Divine Person and Human united in to one hypostasis, Jesus Christ – He is both perfectly Divine and perfectly Human. Likewise, from two natures to one nature means Divine nature and Human nature perfectly united into one united nature. We believe that this incarnation is without alteration/change, without reversion, without mingling/mixing, without dwelling, without superimposing, without separation, and without detachment.

(Part 6, continues )👇

text.text: The incarnated Lord Jesus Christ is truly God

text: . As He truly is God, He rebuked the sea (Matt 8:23), created eyes (John 9:6) and entered through closed doors (John 20:26). These are possible only for a supernatural power. Moreover, many verses about Jesus’ birth confirm that He truly is God (Luke 2:11 Matt 2:11 Isai 9:6).

text.text: The incarnated Lord Jesus Christ is also a Human being.

text: He was sleeping (Matt 8:23). He spat on the ground (John 9:6). He ate after resurrection (Luke 24:42). All these confirm that He is also a human being.

text.text: In short, He is God and human; yet Christ is not two, but one. He is one, however, not by his divinity being turned into flesh, but by God’s taking humanity to himself. He is one, certainly not by the blending of his essence, but by the unity of his person. For just as one human is both rational soul and flesh, so too the one Christ is both God and human.

text: St. Cyril revealed the mystery of Christ's being a man as the mystery of salvation, and said, "

text.text: Before being a man, Christ is God; And when he is a man, he is God.

text:
(Religious Father - St. Cyril. Chapter 79, Section 48, Verse 9-18)

St John the Evangelist clearly stated the Divinity of Jesus Christ as “He is the true God and eternal life” (1 John 5:20). After resurrection of Jesus Christ, Thomas answered and said unto Him, “My Lord and my God!” (John 20:28). All the disciples taught about the Divinity of Jesus Christ. In more definitive terms Jesus Christ Himself said “I Am Alpha And Omega, The Beginning And The Ending,”(Rev 1:8) and “‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ (Matt 22:31).

- We believe that incarnation is from two natures to one; from two persons to one. text: (Part 7)

The mystery of baptism is one of the five pillars of mysteries in the Orthodox Tewahdo church. Baptism means immersion in blessed water (in the name of the Holy Trinity). Adam and Eve, by their choice, became slaves to the devil's will. The Lord appeared to save us, and at the age of 30, he was baptized in the Jordan Sea by the hands of John.

The Lord is naturally compassionate, and He wasn't baptized because He needed it. He washed away our sins by being baptized, but not for the sake of adding glory to himself. He had nothing to lack or add to himself because he was baptized or not. He prophesied that he would baptize. Because he pretended to be an example, he was baptized by the hand of John in the Jordan Sea and became an example for us. And so do we. “And now why are you waiting? Arise and be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord." According to the instructions of Acts 22:16, we are baptized in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

The mystery of baptism is established by our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. He established it in three ways: by performance, preaching, and giving commission to the church. He established baptism by being our role model and getting baptized by John the Baptist in the Jordan River. (Matthew 3) He cemented the place of baptism in Christian life by establishing baptism through His preaching, as he said, “He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned.” Mark 16:16 says, “Unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.” John 3:3-6. He also commissioned the Church to perform baptism as He ordered his disciples: “Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.” Matt 28:19

So, for all who believe in the mystery of the Trinity and the mystery of our incarnation, baptism is our power to erase sin, to receive childhood, and to inherit the kingdom of heaven. "He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned." Mar. 16:16. Baptism is the gate, door, or point of entry to Christianity. One cannot be a Christian without baptism. It’s the first sacrament to be performed for all Christians.

We also believe in baptism for the remission of sins. St. Peter told the people to repent and be baptized: “Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins.” Acts 2:38. This is a type of baptism for the remission of sins; there is another type of baptism in which we are baptized on a regular basis for blessing and healing from sickness; the other is sprinkling with holy water to be blessed in holy water during Epiphany to celebrate Jesus' baptism every year; all of these types of baptisms are reputable. But baptism of rebirth, to which we refer in this topic, is the most important of all these types of regular baptism; baptism of rebirth is a necessity for salvation. It’s not just a mere ceremony. It is the type of baptism that is at the heart of church teachings on the Mystery of Baptism.

(Part 8, to be continued) 👇

Instead, a baptism of repentance will be conducted. text.text: The Link Between Repentance and Humility

text:
In an age when "self-focus" is the rule of the day, and where the ego seems to reign, it is hard for people to see the value of humility. Many people, from politicians to rock stars, seem to climb the ladder of success by being anything but humble. In our darkened state, with sin dominating our lives, and bad habits seemingly insurmountable, holiness seems to be about saints, but unattainable for ourselves. Stuck in our habitual patterns of behavior, we seem to have surrendered all hope for real change.

The antidote to this inertia can be found in one simple act, that of repenting. We fall down before our God, confessing our failure at having kept the commandments, and asking for God's help in turning our lives around. We commit ourselves to crushing down the ego, and acquiring a humble heart. We take every opportunity to accept correction or criticism, without becoming defensive, for we know the truth in the words of Saint John Climacus, "As with the appearance of light, darkness retreats; so, at the fragrance of humility, all anger and bitterness vanishes."

We refrain from judging anyone, but only examine our own conscience, accusing only ourselves. Saint Macarius the Great wrote, “Christians therefore ought to strive continually, and never to pass judgment on anyone—no, not upon the harlot on the street, or upon open sinners and disorderly persons—but to regard all men with singleness of intention and purity of eye, so that it may become like a fixed law of nature to despise no one, to abhor no one, to make no distinctions between them….This is purity of heart, when you see  sinners or sick people, to have compassion on them and be tenderhearted towards them.”

text.text: Source: Abbot Tryphon from the Russian Orthodox Church

. Since we all face similar struggles in life, we can all learn from one another. Hence we entrust you all to read and learn from the answers we give.

Question – If a person who has committed a sin dies suddenly without repenting, can he enter heaven or not?

Answer –

text:
"I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live" says God (Ez 33:11). Suppose a person has lived a righteous and Christian life by continuously repenting, for example. In that case, even if they die with a sin they forgot to confess or repent for, they can still receive the prayer of absolution at the time of their burial, which enables their souls to be with God. But for those that have lived a sinful life, a life without repentance, they should not receive the prayer of absolution upon their death. That said even after our death, Saints and Angels pray for us so we can enter the kingdom of God. This is one of the reasons why it is crucial to pray for the intercession of Angeles and Saints, especially to the Virgin Mary, as she is the mother of God.

Advise፦ it is important to understand that our life here on earth is very short. We do not know when our time will come. Which is why it being essential to always be prepared by repenting every time we sin. God is givining us one extra day, multiple times, as a chance for us to return to Him. We need to use our time wisely by worshiping God, abiding by His commandments, lerning His words, having a pure heart helping to poor and so on.

text.text: Question: Where do thoughts of sin come from? Do all our thoughts come from our own mind or from somewhere else? How do we know the difference between inside and outside? How can we stop?

text: Sin and death are not created by God, but are events that happened later in the life of mankind. Therefore, God did not create sin in Adam's character. Sin is rather the result of an evil though that is contrary to the good laws cealed in his conscience. A person becomes cunning and sinful not because it is given to him by his nature, but because he loves sin by his own free will. Of course, Satan is also the enemy of mankind, so he sees our small weak side and expands it. Therefore, using our free will, we can obey God's law and live righteously. But if we choose to live in Satan's thoughts, we will bring destruction and death to ourselves and others by our own hands. Intellectual (knowledge) is a spiritual gift and wealth that protects the soul, guides and corrects it, and keeps it away from sin and clings to what is good; By this we can distinguish between good and evil. As humans, we have the ability to save ourselves, and this ability is done voluntarily. God foresaw our weakness and made laws for us to live. After people understand God's law, his love and his judgement, the choice is in their hands, so they can think and go for what they want. If they do evil, they will perish, but if they do good, they will be justified. Since we are given the mind to distinguish between good and bad thoughts, it is possible to distinguish whether it is an internal thought that is a characteristic of the soul or an evil thought that comes from someone else. The law is one of the ways in which the divine protection is manifested, and it is shown that the result of God's protection and blessing is with us when we obey God's commands and exercise our free will. This is the will of the soul, which is called the will of the character, and the will of the soul is to live in righteousness, holiness, thanksgiving, and spirituality. In addition, we have the natural ability to prevent the sin of thought from coming, even if it does come, it will not be considered a sin. Therefore, we can use our free will to avoid evil thoughts.

God's creations are called creatures, and a change in the creation is called an event. Therefore, sin and death are not creatures created by God, but events that occurred later in the life of humanity. Therefore, sin is not the nature that God created in Adam's character. Instead, sin is the result of an evil action that is contrary to the good laws given to man by his God written in a book, and carved by his conscience.

Some wrongly believe that if God did not create sin, then it must be the creation of the devil and give the devil the honor of being the creator. The truth is that the devil does not have the ability and capacity to create evil or good things, but to destroy what has been created. The devil originated sin in his nature, he did not create it. However, our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ said that it is the "father of lies". (John 8:44)

The devil and his army sinned by their own free will and put their righteousness aside. This was not imposed on them by another body. Death is not the nature of man, but it suits his nature. Likewise, sin is not a natural characteristic of the devil or human beings, but because it suits their nature, they have become sinners. All creation is given a thinking mind to think. It is impossible to think with our mind and not to know. Satan was an angel by nature, but by his own pride he was called Satan. A man is cunning not because he is naturally cunning, but because he likes trickery of his own free will. So it is our own free will and choice that destroyed us. God did not create any sin. But we ourselves have loved evil and committed sin. The will of the character is the will of the soul, and the will of the soul is to live in righteousness, holiness, thanksgiving, and spirituality.

Therefore, sin is the fault of humans and angels, not God's responsibility, nor is there any reason connected with their nature, so they are responsible only for themselves. The human being, endowed with understanding and wisdom, whose grace resembles God, who is created free of will, and who has power over himself, is the cause of evil and evil for each of his own lives. Man, using his free will, sometimes becomes righteous and sometimes sinful. As the Prophet said, "The human race was glorious, but they became like animals without a heart." Mankind's main adversary is the devil, but not all of our downfalls are attributable to Satan. Even if there is no such thing as Satan, as long as human beings do not use their free will properly, it is bound to stumble (fall). In fact, the scriptures tell us about the fierce struggle of the devil by saying, "Your partner the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour." Even so, he has no power unless he gets free consent from us.

This ability is voluntary and supported by behavior. The apostle St. Paul said, "Every man deserves to be commanded." 2 Pet 2:19 We can be slaves to those whom we love and to whom we obey. In his message, the apostle Saint James said, "Each one is tempted when he is drawn and deceived by his own desire, and if desire is conceived, it gives birth to sin, and if sin is conceived, it gives birth to death" (James 4:14-15). May God cut off the cord of sin that we are willingly drawn into.

text.text: How to stop recurring bad thoughts in the mind permanently?

Question: I know that when bad thoughts come to our mind, we can choose not to accept them and not think about them, but is it possible to control our thoughts so that we don't have disturbing or bad thoughts that come to our mind in the first place? How can we permanently stop the bad thoughts that are repeatedly formed in our mind?

✍Answer
The main reason for us to commit sin, either internally generated from ourselves or under the pressure of external forces, is the absence of righteousness or the deficiency of our inner spirituality
External sources of sin are trained against us when our intimate relationship with our God begins to falter.

text.text: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil

Stand therefore, having your loins girt with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness; And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace; Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked. And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints; And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel," he told us (Ephesians 6:11-19)

Therefore

. The one who has received the title 'heart of God', Saint David, in his psalms says, "You will be righteous with the righteous, you will be pure with the pure, you will be upright with the upright, and you will be crooked with the crooked" (Ps 17:25-27).

What makes man human and separates him from animals is not only his knowledge but also his free will. In other words, our soul has the freedom to be whatever it wants

This is possible by thinking of the words, "

But sin and righteousness do not continue to live together. In addition, if we regularly wash away sin with repentance, and practice planting good things in our minds little by little, the thought of sin will be replaced by righteousness.

text.text: When does a thought become a sin? Which thoughts should we confess and should we confess all bad thoughts?

Question: Is it when we allow and choose to focus on evil thoughts that it becomes a sin or when the thought first pops into our mind? How do we know which thoughts to confess? Do we repent only for the bad thoughts that we have entertained, or also for those that we have rejected when our thoughts flashed? Even if we try to worship and think about something else, if we don't get rid of the bad thoughts that pop up in our heads, do we also confess about them? Do we confess all the bad thoughts that pop into our heads?

Answer:

text: There are many types and methods of sin which all fall under 3 categories: thoughts, words and actions. Every evil desire that a person has brought out in his inner conscience and has not yet put into action is called the
. This sin becomes
when it is spoken by the mouth. And if the sin that is said orally is put into action, it is called the

.

The foundation of sin is thought, because no sin is committed without thought. If something happens unexpectedly, it is not often questioned. But he will be punished for not being careful in his simplicity. 

Therefore, every human being must get rid of the thoughts that are the root of sin. We should immediately correct ourselves by calling on the name of God and condemning Satan as it flashes in our mind. Therefore, when the thought of sin comes to our heart, if we immediately repent in our conscience and return to our mind, that is, without entertaining the thought, without saying it in words and without putting into action, then if we go to the priest and receive his blessings, kiss his cross, our sins will be forgiven. This is through the  authority given to the priest from God; saying  "Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven" Mat 18.18

However, it is important to understand that this kind of approach or receiving blessings from the priest does not free us from sins that we have committed by speech or by action. Also, as stated above, if we intend to do it and end up not because of inconvinient circumstances, it is considered that we have committed the sin of thought. Hence we need to repent for it. At that time, all the damage we have done earlier knowingly and boldly, or unknowingly by mistake, will be forgiven all together.

text.text: Question: I could not get rid of the sin of adultery, what should I do? (What is the cause and solution?)

text: : Adultery is one of the main sins that God detests, hates and grieves. Adultery is sexual intercourse outside of one's husband or wife. Therefore, it is important to understand that the main function of adultery is to change the law of God with the law of the devil, which means changing our eternal life with eternal death. That is why our enemy, Satan the Devil, uses it as his main weapon to make us fall apart from the Creator and make us commit this type of sin that is most hated in the sight of God. Saitan makes us fall in this sin  by regularly tempting us in all it's different forms, and making everyone cooperate in this sin.

- When we are faced with sinful thoughts and actions that originate from inside or outside for various reasons, we often submit our free will to our temporary feelings and fall into sin. To get rid of this, knowing God, knowing the honor God has given to man, and doing spiritual work will help us to use our free will in a good way that God loves. There is no nobler creature than man; God's prophet David said, "Man was glorious, but he did not know it and became like an animal." When God gave human beings a mind to distinguish between good and evil, He set laws but with free will.

     Psalm 33:14 says, "Flee from evil, and do good." Therefore, if we keep the law and do good, we will be justified, and if we do not, we will be condemned. Therefore, it is important to know God's law and perform spiritual activities, such as fasting, prayer, prostration, reading spiritual books, prostrating, listening to hymns, listening to sermons, attending liturgy, regularly meeting with spiritual father (in person or over the phone) and regularly taking part of the Eucharist. When we strive to do these things, the spirit cannot stay in us, so it burns and moves away from us.
-

-

We must always understand that the the evil spirit is able to make us sin because of our weak thoughts, attitudes, inclinations and desires. If Satan finds the small hole of the will, he will lick it like a snake and widen it, and he will lose us from our God. Therefore, even if we ourselves are partial to our own flesh and say that we have been misled to make Satan the reason for all the sins we have boldly committed, we will not escape responsibility. Therefore, it is better to be aware of Satan's methods, tools and ways he uses to tempt us, so that we will  stay away from sin. "Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices". (2 Cor 2:11)

Therefore, we should repent for this. We should stop sinning not only with action, but also with words and thoughts.

text.text: 4. Living with an active conscience, praying

text: To lead a person to sin, Satan does not initially concern himself with major sins. For example, if Satan wants to make someone commit adultery, he does not force the person to commit adultery directly, but first weakens his spiritual life by making him lazy so that he stops praying for example. Then he slowly leads him to the biggest sin of adultery.  In general, what he does before anything else is to separate the conscience from being one with its Lord, so that it does not notice what Saitan is doing. So we must pray, seek the Father of the soul, and read the scriptures. (1st Cor 7:34) there is nothing that Satan loves more than hindering prayer, because prayer is an arrow that pierces his eyes.  Therefore, we should always live in prayer and with an active conscience.

Eating too much is one of the main causes of adultery. The more food we eat, the more temptations we have. Just like when we add more wood or gas to a fire, it will raise high, increasing the amount of food will also  increases the sensuality; but when we eat less, our flesh will be less powerful and out spirit more powerful.

Among the ways of salvation that Satan fights for, there is none greater than repentance. This is because repentance destroys all the edifices of sin that the enemy, the devil, has built to destroy the lives of Christians, making it not exist by the grace of God. There is no sin that repentance does not wash away. Therefore, the devil fights in various ways too drive us away from repentance. Therefore, we need to be alert and repent today without taking any more time.

Even if we fail at one time, we must keep going until the end, even if we fall we must get up and never give up. It should be expected that the fight will be difficult, it will be exhausting, the devil doesn't want us free so when he knows we are struggling, he will fight back stronger. As St. Paul said, "Your battle is not against fleshly creatures, but against subtle spirits." God has given us the tools which enables us win, the choice is at our hand but needs commitment without giving up.

8

So we must pray, seek the Father of the soul, and read the scriptures. (1st Cor 7:34) there is nothing that Satan loves more than hindering prayer, because prayer is an arrow that pierces his eyes.  Therefore, we should always live in prayer and with an active conscience.

5. Eating less

Eating too much is one of the main causes of adultery. The more food we eat, the more temptations we have. Just like when we add more wood or gas to a fire, it will raise high, increasing the amount of food will also  increases the sensuality; but when we eat less, our flesh will be less powerful and out spirit more powerful. 

6. Repentance 

Among the ways of salvation that Satan fights for, there is none greater than repentance. This is because repentance destroys all the edifices of sin that the enemy, the devil, has built to destroy the lives of Christians, making it not exist by the grace of God. There is no sin that repentance does not wash away. Therefore, the devil fights in various ways too drive us away from repentance. As St. Paul said, "Your battle is not against fleshly creatures, but against subtle spirits." God has given us the tools which enables us win, the choice is at our hand but needs commitment without giving up.

Another reason that makes us vulnerable to adultery is our lack of understanding about marriage. We are going to send you some of the teachings and advice written about marriage in order to help the believers in general to walk properly according to God's -  learning about the spirituality of marriage and what our married life should look like is a must for every Christian.

Question #1: I have a lot of problems in my marriage. My marriage was done in church, in the Holy Communion! What do you recommend??

👉 Question #2:- I could not be a good wife. When I fight with my husband, I insult him, and want to strangle him very bad. What do you advise me?

✍Answer

text: : Our dear member, basically, our church teaches that any Christian should not be separated from the Holy Body and the Precious Blood from the time they receive the sonship of God through Baptism and are sealed with the Holy Communion on the 40th or 80th day of their life until the end. Along with this,

text.text: the Church emphasizes that it is a Christian obligation to marry in the Holy Communion.

Because what makes our marriage real is if we are married in the sacrament. As it is written, "the two shall become one flesh" during the sacred marriage ceremony, the great mystery of which the two bodies are transformed into physical unity and spiritual unity though Christ's Holy Body and His Precious Blood. (Mark 10:8). Apart from this, if it is a worldly marriage, this mystery will not be fulfilled in which the two become one. In short, this pair cannot be called two but one.

text:
Of course, when we think the fact that many believers are getting married in the secular system like the Gentiles, we appreicate your  appropriate Christian behavior to decide to perform your marriage in the Holy Communion; grace and blessings will be abundant for you. No matter how many lies and illegalities abound, those have never replaced a single truth; God's law never changes. Therefore, we recommend that people who are married in a worldly system without knowing this truth and God's law, should repent and be united in the sacrament so that their marriage can be called a true marriage. The reason we want to explain all this in our introduction is to create awareness for other members as well  based on the idea that our questioner's  raised  about getting married in Holy Communion.

Dear member, in your question, it seems that you have lost hope and already concluded the problem your marriage encountered cannot be solved at all. But you didn't specificaly mention to us what the problem is. Identifying the problem correctly is getting half of the solution so it would have been very useful if you specified. 

Hence, in response to your question, even if you have not mentioned the challenges you faced, we hereby explained to you a general way and perspective of how to manage your marriage with spiritual wisdom, so we entrust you to implement our advice:

text.text: There are two things that make a spiritual marriage strong. One is to be united in religion (live in religion) and the other is to be united in purity (righteousness)
The lack thereof is what destroys marriages.

text: In other words, marriage is a partnership in which the spouses agree that there is nothing that can separate them apart from death, adultery, and changing their religion. Therefore, if marriage is a place where people enter and do not leave, then we should be careful and aware enough to enter into it not blindly but with knowledge.

text.text: Therefore, it is important to learn about the nature of marriage before marriage. A house can support its roof only when its foundation is strong, and marriage requires preparation not only for temporary feelings and happiness, but also for challenges that may be faced in the long run.

text:
Indeed, some marriages bring blessings to husband and wife, children, and others. And some marriages don't come with this. What is the difference? The main difference between these marriages is the purpose of the marriage. If they get married for material things, or to satisfy their lust, or any other similar worldly view, the marriage will not bring blessings. Those who get married with the goal of righteousness and to travel with the spiritual goal of attaining salvation and eternal life, their marriage brings great happiness and blessing not only to the couple, but also to their children and other people.   

(to be continued)👇

text.text: St. John the Baptist taught us, this is why God instituted marriage - for those who cannot lead a monastic life, to live in marriage with the goal of righteousness!!!
Therefore, disagreements in Orthodox marriage can be compared to the Cross of Christ which we are called to carry.

text: Marriage requires not only happiness but also a willingness to bear these crosses. Therefore, some of the disagreements between the couple come from losing the orthodox path, forgetting the vision (purpose) of orthodox marriage, and not remembering that there is salvation, healing, justification, and blessing in the middle of the struggle. Therefore, the challenges we face in marriage can be overcome with wisdom and love. The important thing is that even if our spouse does not do what is expected of us, we should look at what is expected of ourselves in terms of the purpose of marriage.

text.text: Marriage is not a worldly life of competition or abandonment, but the purpose of being justified by walking together and supporting each other.

text:
For this is either marriage in Christ or spiritual marriage. The martyrs entered the kingdom of heaven because they were killed by the sword and shed their blood for the sake of their religion, so we who are asked for a lesser price than this, should see our marriage as a good way of salvation and justification, and we deserve to fulfill our duty to live in love.

Even if there is a problem that is beyond our control, we should discuss how to cope, how to correct this mistake and solve the problem by talking openly, but we should not enter into inappropriate satanic thinking, hatred and revenge. Even God, who is pure by nature, did not want to destroy us after seeing all this dirty work of ours.

text.text: Therefore, at any time, anywhere, any situation witout condition, since we the marriage promise we made is for our common purpose, we should mainly live with complete sympathy, love and forgiveness for our spouse.

text:
Even if there is a problem that is beyond our control, we should go as far as possible and solve the problem by talking openly about the way to correct our mistake in order to overcome it with the spirit of patience, forgiveness and tolerance. There is no one who can do my pre than we can to save our marriage, our children, and our future lives, so we ourselves, individually and collectively, must be ready to pay any price.

Therefore, we need to talk openly about the challenges and disagreements we may face in our marriage and how we can overcome them.

text.text: Marriage is where we learn about love, where we live love, where we understand the love of Christ. Christ the Bridegroom loves the Church with a selfless and unconditional love. The love in marriage is the key to this perfect love as St. Gregory the Great tells us. "If we love one another, God will live in us, and his love is perfected in us." When we show this love in practice, we wash away our sins with that love (1 John 4:12). This is why we call marriage a journey of righteousness.

text: The Church is Christ's body and bridegroom, and the wife is her husband's body and bridegroom. In order for the body to function in a healthy manner, unless the feet or hands are sick, it works without disobedience. This is the body's system (nature). A wife is equal to her husband and they are one body. Therefore, she should submit to her husband as she submits to the Lord for their common health. (Eph 5:22)

text.text: This is the Christian order (nature). One of the things that make a family not run properly is to confuse this transience (nature). We should remember that when a wife obeys her husband, she is participating in our Lord's work of salvation, not the obedience of a master and a slave. A wife obeying her husband does not mean that her husband is perfect. The only perfect bridegroom (husband) is our Lord Jesus Christ!

Therefore, no matter how weak a husband is, you should not despise him. If you want to correct his weakness, as St. Peter advised us, "Wives, if some of your husbands are disobedient to teaching, submit to them so that they may find instruction in the lives of their wives, watching your chaste lives with fear" (1 Peter 3:1).

The fathers say, "May God throw all the anger, the quarrels, the sickness, the spirit of hatred into the sea and into the cliff." We should learn from the Bible, from history and from other people we know or heared that there is no  justification for a fight, no justification for divorce. In general, marriage is martyrdom, and our ancestors achieved martyrdom through many hardships, but our martyrdom is mainly to live patiently with the marriage we started.

Therefore, our dear member, we have briefly explained the spirituality of marriage above in this lesson, we believe that if you understand this properly, you will have learned the wisdom of caring instead of fighting, being one instead of being separated, loving instead of revenge and resentment, loving instead of hating, being justified instead of being lost.

We give you this as a general understanding and advice and we will give you advice based on the rest when you identify the problem you are facing and let us know. So contact us soon before Satan escalates the problem and turns your life into a chaos.

May the name of the Holy God be praised forever and ever in every tongue that He has created, today and always. 

May the blessings of God's mother, the virgin, and the cross be upon us.
Amen.

spiritual service

This service is the English version of our Amharic service

The purpose of this service is to bridge the language barrier that many face when trying to learn about the faith and bring the success we had with the Amharic program to a whole new set of audience. 

We provide 24/7 Q&A support, lessons on the major feasts, lessons on the teachings of the church, a medium where fellow Orthodox can connect, discuss and encourage one onother. Members can ask publicly on Telegram or privately on Facebook, Telegram or using our email address. 

We also provide spiritual support over phone by assisting in a number of ways. 

We post everyday at 11:30pm EST on Telegram and have presence in other social medias as well:

(click English for language)

The intended audience for our service is anyone age 16 and up. This is a very safe space where people ask about anything and everything which is why we have an age restriction. However we do not have a faith restriction: anyone who wants to learn about the faith is welcome. They can ask questions, read what we post, call us and use the service to help them in their spiritual journey. 

Our service is not common and the best way to understand the value we offer is to experience it by asking questions, reading regularly, inviting friends, communicating with your fellow brothes and sisters, calling us for spiritual support, staying fully engaged and

You may also share hyms, icons, news and so forth that you think is super useful to your Orthodox brothers and sisters as long as it doesn't have a link.

You can search through content using this method: 

Say you want to read about marriage, then you search

and all the answers and lessons that have 'marriage' as their topic will show up. If you want to read a lesson, you choose the ones that has 3 hands (👉🏾👉🏾👉🏾) whereas if you want Q&A, you choose the ones thtat have 1 hand only (👉🏾). 

Say you want to search all the content that have both 'repentance' and 'fornication' in the topic, then you search:

and you will get all the relevant results. 

Clicking the highlighted text above will also take you to those topics.

This service has the blessings of Abune Ermias (Bishop) which can be seen in some of our YouTube videos (in Amharic), is mainly lead by Like Hiruyan Tserse Abebe (Priest, church Scholar and head of the EOTC's public relations department), Aba Wolde Giorgis (Monk), Memeher Simur Getenet (priest and Church scholar)

Although the above are the major personals in the service, there are numerous others who serve day and night as volunteers.

Although the Church that has initiated this service is the EOTC, we sometimes reference and allow you to post material from any Orthodox Church, eastern and oriental.   

It is the order of God that His people first be served and thus we have done for the past three years with the Amharic service. By the will of God we are now providing the service in English so everyone can learn about the true faith regardless of their background. Hence we urge you to spread awareness of this service and be a reason for the salvation of your friends, family and even coworkers. Do not hide God's talent in the ground (The Parable of the Talents Matthew 25:14-30)

May the name of the Holy God be praised forever and ever in every tongue that He has created, today and always. 

May the blessings of God's mother, the virgin, and the cross be upon us.
Amen.

text.text: "Beloved people of God, we greet you with the greetings of God, who are following the orthodox education transmitted by John's Repentance telegram website. We have sent you below to read the decision of the Holy Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church today, February 4, 2023 (Tir 27, 2015 E.C.)"
The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church passed the following resolutions in an emergency meeting called by the Holy Synod.

text: . The Holy Synod strongly condemns the illegal arrest and harassment of Archbishops and Diocese Managers, Heads of Departments, Priests and the faithful;

On February 4, 2023 (Tir 27, 2015 E.C) in Shashemene city of Western Arsi Diocese, in Debre Sebhat St. Michael local church, the Holy Synod completely condemns the illegal human rights violation and the brutal death of the parishioners who came out to protect the church. The Holy Synod decided that prayer of absolution should be done in all localities by making appropriate synodal and religious prayers;

It is recalled that in the decision and statement of the Holy Synod on February 3, 2023 (Tir 26, 2015 E.C.), all the followers of the church should fast the fast of Nineveh and dress black throughout the entire fast.

. We see that it is necessary to draw up a detailed implementation guide for this. For 3 days starting from Februarh 6, 2023 (Tir 29, 2015 E. C), the Holy Synod decided that all the priests and laymen in all the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo churches, all over the world should wear all black and hold prayer ceremonies in the churches and monasteries.

In all activities during this time, be sure to wear black clothes as it is the Holy Synod's order. However, after the Holy Synod announced this order  international schedule of prayers and dress code yesterday, we understand that black clothes are being taken out of the market in various cities. The Holy Synod has decided that you should use the similar clothes that you have and carry out the decision of the Holy Synod in all your activities.

During these days, the Holy Synod decided that the service should be performed with a loudspeaker and that the service should be performed full time and that during the seven hours of prayer, the bells shall be rang for five straight minutes without ceasing.
. The Holy Synod has decided that the parish councils of each diocese, district church and local churches should monitor and enforce this.
We call on sister churches, the Orthodox world, any religious or social institutions and individuals who know and support the truth to stand together in support of the call of our Holy Church.
. In these times of prayer and Oath, if hardened hearts do not return to their heart  and apply the call of the Church:

. On February 12, 2023 (Yekatit 5 2015 E.C), Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church priest)s and believers in the country and abroad will attend the Mass from 05:00 am in their local churches until 7:30 am. And the churches ringing the bell at the same time, making all the worshipers gather until 8:30 in the morning; The Holy Synod has decided that a peaceful demonstration should be held from every area to the same place, the baptistry [local area where churches gather for Epiphany - this mainly applies to churches in Ethiopia] or Meskel Square [if in Addis Abeba], celebrating the 'tabot', accompanying it and singing hymns.

. The Holy Synod urges you to make arrangements, knowing that we will inform you in a short time about the detailed instructions for the implementation of this peaceful demonstration.

     5. The Holy Synod urges any security force of the government to realize that it has the duty to provide appropriate protection in any period of service in which the church orders peaceful requests, recognizing that their activities are peaceful.

text.text: It is Christ who founded the Church

Dear and respected members who follow the orthodox education and spiritual service that we convey on the John's Repentance website; This lesson prepared based on the topic is found in the book 'Hebr Serat Zebetristian Orthodox', and we have translated the lesson and made it available to you by referring to the recent challenges the Church has faced: We entrust you all to read it and gain a comprehensive understanding of the connection between the Church and religion.
1. It is Christ who founded the church

text:
Christ founded the church on Peter's religion. Peter's religion is to believe that Christ is God, the Son of God, the Alpha and Omega, who prophesied in the past through the prophets, and who fulfilled the prophecies that God spoke by becoming a man, who is one body from two bodies, one nature from two natures, God. . In order to understand that this religion was Peter's, when the Lord asked the Council of Caesarea, "Who do people call the Son of Man?", the other disciples said what they had heard from people, that they call you Elijah, John the Baptist, one of the prophets, but the question did not end there, because the Lord answered, "Who do you say that I am?" St. Peter replied, "You are the Christ, the Son of the Living God." Matthew 16:16 John 1:41

And another time, when the Lord was teaching about the sacrament, many of the people were going back saying, "This is troubling, who can hear it?" When the Lord asked the apostles, "Would you like to go too?" Saint Peter replied, "Lord. To whom shall we go when you have the promise of eternal life? "We believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God," he testified to his religion and that of his companions. John 6:80-89

In his message, when Saint Peter himself spoke about Christ's death, he said, "He died in the flesh, but he is alive in the spirit (divinity)." 1 Pet 3:19 This is what Peter's religion means. Whoever does not believe in this religion is different from the unity of the church, which is the family of the members of the body of Christ, and is not called a follower of Peter.  Therefore, the orthodox church was founded, stood firmly, and will continue forward, holding this creed of the great apostle St. Peter as its foundation. Rtu Hai page 34

John the Evangelist said this in his message, "Who is a liar but he that denies that Jesus is the Christ?" 1st John 2:22 "Whosoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loves him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him. He said. 1 John 5:1 Therefore, a person is called a Christian when he knows the teaching of the apostles and understands their religion well, accepts it and follows it. Apart from this, a religion made arbitrarily, by chance, by one's will, by one's own philosophy and guidance does not save from judgment. 

What explains that Peter's religion is correct: The Lord heard Peter's words and did not keep silent. "And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven." Matthew 16:16-17. Therefore, Peter's foundation is religion. The religion is "Only son" (The pre-world, born of a father without a mother, the after-world, born of the Virgin Mary without a father, Jesus Christ is an only child.). It is a part of the church of Christ that stands and grows on the rock of Peter. Peter's foundation is belief, and Christ's foundation is trust: "For it has been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you." 11). 1st Qor 1፥11

(continues)👇

For the head is above all the bodies and is the gathering place of all the bodies, and Christ as the head of the church is the home of all believers. "For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones." Eph 5:30 - "The tree was first of all, all things were established by him, he is the head of the church, the first tree was raised from the dead to be the head of all" Col 1:17 Eph 1:21, Eph 5:23

text.text: 2. Be careful ye who build on this foundation

text:
Christ founded the church and did not leave it. He has chosen and appointed seven apostles who will lead and manage the church and teach about Him. "And he gave grace, and appointed apostles from the churches, and from them prophets and evangelists, guardians and teachers, so that the saints may be steadfast in the work of the ministry and the building up of the body of Christ" Ephesians 4:11 1 Corinthians 12:27

Therefore, these appointed, from the believing people and from the Gentiles, teaching, persuading, baptizing, circumcising, presenting to God. Then, with the authority given to them, they confess the believers and confess their sins and ask God for mercy and forgiveness. "For God has reconciled the world to himself in Christ by forgiving their sins and not thinking about their transgressions, and he has made the word of reconciliation to us, and he has given us the message of forgiveness.

This does not mean that they will establish a new foundation, but they will build upon the established one, and prevent it's destruction through education. They prepare the way to God. It means that they strive to bring people to the kingdom of God. "According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon." 1 Cor 3:10

May the name of the Holy God be praised forever and ever in every tongue that He has created, today and always. 

May the blessings of God's mother, the virgin, and the cross be upon us.
Amen.

text.text: Beloved and respected members who follow the orthodox education and spiritual service that we convey on John's Repentance page, we send you this writing about the feast of Naniveh written by Pope Shenouda III of the Coptic Orthodox Church because it is important to understand the story behind it and why we fast, so we can relate to the people of Naniveh, learn from them and get the blessings of this fast which is from February 6-9.

text:
Fast of Nineveh is three days subsequent fast and repentance of the Ninevites by the warning message of the Prophet Jonah. It is known to be the fast of repentance, humility and the return to God. Thus, the Church considers this fast amongst the Great Fast; Lent and other Fasts.

The people of Nineveh fasted, wore sackcloth from the youngest to the oldest and prayed to God for forgiveness. God accepted their repentance; “God saw their works that they turned from their evil way; and God relented from the disaster that He had said He would bring upon them; and He did not do it.” (Jonah 3:10)

The story of Jonah presages the redemptive work of Lord Jesus Christ. God send Prophet Jonah to the people of Nineveh for they were Gentiles and needed repentance. “But in every nation whoever fears Him and works righteousness is accepted by Him.” (Acts 10:35)

God saved the mariners on the boat who were Gentiles through Jonah for they were men seeking the Lord. Tough, they prayed to their gods they knew the true God is the almighty. So, they asked Jonah to pray to his God. Prophet Jonah also told the mariners, “I am a servant of the Lord, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.” Believing his words, they feared the Lord and offered Him sacrifices. (Jonah 1:16, 1:9-10)

Then, even after he told them to throw him in the sea; “They were endeavoring to find God’s will in order that they might carry it out. When the sea ceased its raging by their throwing Jonah into it they were assured of the presence of God in the matter. They believed in the Lord, offered Him a sacrifice and made vows. In their belief in the Lord they not only believed that He was God but by offering Him a sacrifice they professed their belief in the propitiation of blood.” (Jonah 1:13)

However, it was not the will of God for Jonah to drawn, so He prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah and uses the whale to save him. Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights praying to God. At the third day, God answered his prayers and the whale put Jonah put out on dry Land; He did not prepare it to destroy him but to preserve him.

God command Prophet Jonah again to go to Nineveh. He was first commanded to preach the Ninevites although his prophecy did not reach upon them till after the whale had emitted him out.

God saves Jonah from his pride as he was still egocentric when He caused a plant with thick leaves to grow up and shade Jonah from the sun and GOD destroyed the plant with worm. The next day, he suffered from the heat of a wind blow. Once more, with rage, Prophet Jonah wished his death and God reveals his mercy and compassion through the plant.

Prophet Jonah was preaching God’s words to spread His kingdom in Nineveh City and God willed to save Ninevites. “A greater than Jonah is here” Jonah was a figure of Lord Christ. Saint Cyril of Jerusalem says, “As Jonah was thrown to the belly of the whale, the Lord Christ went by His own will to the unseen whale of death, to coerce him to give those who were swallowed by him; as it is written, “I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death.” (Matthew 12:41, Hosea 13:14)

The Ninevites were saved by the Prophet Jonah. Saint John Chrysostom said, “Nineveh freed itself from death by fasting. Like a heavenly power overseeing Nineveh’s charge, fasting snatched the city from the gates of death and returned Nineveh to Life."

text:
Thus, “Let us use these three days to offer repentance from our hearts, as did the Ninevites, seeking the forgiveness of our sins. Let us give thanks to the Lord who prepares our way for us through all tribulations and trials, as He prepared the belly of the whale for Jonah. H.H. Pope Shenouda III – Contemplations on the Book of Jonah the Prophet

text.text: Dear members of John's Repentance page; We have sent you the following educational message regarding the tears of repentance so we entrust you to read and take it to heart as you fast, pray and suppoicate God to send his mercy upon us.

text:
There is a legend that has been told since ancient times. The Almighty God said to the angels, "Go to the earth and bring the most precious things that you find on earth." One of the angels brought a drop of blood that a man had shed to save another man. The Most High God said, "O angel; This that you have brought is glorious in my sight. However, it is not the most glorious one. Another angel came from a patient who died of an infectious disease and a nurse who died from the disease and brought her last breath. The Most High God said, "O angel; This that you have brought is glorious in my sight. However, it is not the most glorious one. Finally, another angel brought the tears of a sinner who had repented in a small cup before God. And God said to the angel, "O angel; "You have brought to me the most noble thing in the world," he replied. (Philokalia: the Bible of Orthodox Spirituality p.159)

The way for a person to return to God after he has sinned is through tears of repentance. The psalmist, Saint David, often tells us about the blessed pearl of the Holy Spirit. Let's notice what he said, "I wash my bed all night long, and I wipe my bed with my tears." He said this because his repentance is through the grace and mercy of the Holy Spirit. For his repentance was not in vain like the repentance of Judas. Again, the psalmist tells us that "weeping will come in the evening, but in the morning there will be joy" (Ps 29 (30):5). This signifies the joy of the Holy Spirit given with tears. It is related to what the Lord said in the Gospel, "Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted" (Matthew 5:4). Tears give spiritual rest to the soul lost in sin, and cause it to gain insight and the revelation of mysteries. When the Holy Gospel talks about Saint Peter, it says, "He went outside and wept bitterly" (Luke 22:62). He received the great responsibility to feed and lead the believers after walking in tears

Our ancestors taught that tears are a gift from God to give birth to a new life. Baptism is one; If a person sins after baptism and is in the work of death, his return and "rebirth" is this tear of repentance. Through the tears of repentance, he renews the grace that he received in baptism, but which was later corrupted by sin.

St. John the Baptist said, "The fire of sin is steadfast." But a few drops of tears extinguishes the burning of mistakes (like fire) and purifies our souls. He teaches us this spiritual lesson. Because the tears of true repentance are a gift from God, it explains to us that no matter how bad a person's wrongdoing is, it has the power to destroy that serious sin. St. John said this to indicate that a person can do wrong because of his free will, and whether he does not use it, will be questioned at the time of judgment. We find this holy father often teaching about tears of repentance. One of his teachings where he explained that "tears are both the mother and child of prayer" is worth mentioning. Tears have a great place for a person's eternal life and the union of grace with God. It makes a person compassionate, pure, loving others, forgiving and humble. If he does this, he will live forever as his creator (God).

In general, all members; Thinking only of God's things, we should repent, be in a broken heart to fulfill our canon properly, and pray with tears; Similarly, if we come across other things that can mislead or distract us, we recommend that we need to stay away from them so that we don't fall into sin.

We will return in the next lesson about the obstacles to repentance, so stay tuned

However, it is not the most glorious one. Another angel came from a patient who died of an infectious disease and a nurse who died from the disease and brought her last breath. The Most High God said, "O angel; This that you have brought is glorious in my sight. However, it is not the most glorious one. Finally, another angel brought the tears of a sinner who had repented in a small cup before God. And God said to the angel, "O angel; "You have brought to me the most noble thing in the world," he replied. (Philokalia: the Bible of Orthodox Spirituality p.159)

The way for a person to return to God after he has sinned is through tears of repentance. The psalmist, Saint David, often tells us about the blessed pearl of the Holy Spirit. Let's notice what he said, "I wash my bed all night long, and I wipe my bed with my tears." He said this because his repentance is through the grace and mercy of the Holy Spirit. For his repentance was not in vain like the repentance of Judas. Again, the psalmist tells us that "weeping will come in the evening, but in the morning there will be joy" (Ps 29 (30):5). This signifies the joy of the Holy Spirit given with tears. It is related to what the Lord said in the Gospel, "Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted" (Matthew 5:4). Tears give spiritual rest to the soul lost in sin, and cause it to gain insight and the revelation of mysteries. When the Holy Gospel talks about Saint Peter, it says, "He went outside and wept bitterly" (Luke 22:62). He received the great responsibility to feed and lead the believers after walking in tears

Our ancestors taught that tears are a gift from God to give birth to a new life. Baptism is one; If a person sins after baptism and is in the work of death, his return and "rebirth" is this tear of repentance. Through the tears of repentance, he renews the grace that he received in baptism, but which was later corrupted by sin.

St. John the Baptist said, "The fire of sin is steadfast." But a few drops of tears extinguishes the burning of mistakes (like fire) and purifies our souls. He teaches us this spiritual lesson. Because the tears of true repentance are a gift from God, it explains to us that no matter how bad a person's wrongdoing is, it has the power to destroy that serious sin. St. John said this to indicate that a person can do wrong because of his free will, and whether he does not use it, will be questioned at the time of judgment. We find this holy father often teaching about tears of repentance. One of his teachings where he explained that "tears are both the mother and child of prayer" is worth mentioning. Tears have a great place for a person's eternal life and the union of grace with God. It makes a person compassionate, pure, loving others, forgiving and humble. If he does this, he will live forever as his creator (God).

In general, all members; Thinking only of God's things, we should repent, be in a broken heart to fulfill our canon properly, and pray with tears; Similarly, if we come across other things that can mislead or distract us, we recommend that we need to stay away from them so that we don't fall into sin.

text.text: The category and level of this sin; its Cause; and its Impact and the Solution
Category and level of Masterbation sin.

text:
Masturbation is one of the highest level of sin that is outside the law and order of nature. This type of sin, which Satan has devised as a new philosophy of fornication, is called Masterbation. It is a shameful act of sex with oneself in which a man spills his seed hiding behind a closed door and burning with adultery desire, for he failed to control his tempted emotion for a second. The main method by which Satan makes people easily subject to this sin is through a secret way of individiual training so that men and women assured themselves as if they did not committed adultery as long as they didn't sleep with or get near to anyone. However, this is even graver failure than those who commit adultery between a man and a woman because it is out of natural law and order. In fact, the idea of homosexuality starts from this and it is connected to the spirit of homosexuality. It can be understood from the stories in the Bible that it is a type of sin that will destroy the world if people refuse to repent by cooprating in this sin.

In this age, it is a type of sin that children and adults are suffering from, and many of them have been trained secretly by Satan since their childhood. What's worse is that the sin is private and hidden, and apart from being hard to control, it is difficult to get rid of the habit that one has been accustomed to since childhood. Many people knowingly or unknowingly started it as easy and simple, but it becomes hard to talk openly about their problem or to repent ; as they feel ashamed; so most did not find a solution.  But when we say all these, we are not shaming or pressing their wounds, but it is intended mainly to give lesson to show that it is the path of destruction that Satan has opened for people. So that they need to decide to get rid of this sin once and for all and repent.

On the other hand, for those who have not committed this sin, it is said in the Holy Book to "flee from fornication" (1 Cor 6:18), so that God may protect them from this evil and they should understand the severity of the sin of fornication in advance and refrain from this danger. Therefore, it is necessary for you to understand that , the reason  we talk about this subject again and again is that the youth of our time are lost due to lack of mentors and teachers. As it is said, "My people are lost for lack of knowledge" (Hosea 4:6).

In general, it is important to understand that the main function of adultery is to replace God's law with the devil's law, which means replacing our eternal life with eternal death. That is why our enemy, Satan the devil, is using this type of adultery as his main weapon to separate us from the Creator and is fighting to bring all mankind to the same path of destruction. When everyone joins in sin, the destruction it brings not only to the individual, but also to the country and the earth. As you know, the main cause of the plagues that happened to the people of Noah's day was the sin of adultery.
Let's look at the main problems and effects of masterbation:

if a person is  virgin but keeps on committing masterbation, he/she can't say I am a virgin simply because he/she doesn't slept with a woman or a man, or touched anyone. but if we say so,  1st/ We are lying to ourselves and to God, 2nd/ We are committing homosexual acts on ourselves, 3rd/ We are wasting our seed. Therefore, a person who falls into the sin of mastrbation  is considered to have done worse than adultery with a man or woman outside of marriage. In addition, the possibility of partaking of spiritual gifts and ceremonies where virginity is a primary requirement becomes questionable. It is because Satan knows this that he has been training us in the work of destruction since we were very young, so that he can easily make us fall down and deprive us of glory.

(to be continued)👇

text.text: 4. Absence of conscious awareness and not praying

text: Not being diligent in the spiritual life will make us pay a big price. If our lives are not guided by the mentorship of a penitent father, by fasting, prayer and worship, we will be close to Satan's temptations. Therefore, fasting, prayer and prostration are required. There should be a private prayer that you pray morning and night without ceasing. Also, as much as the spirit dwells in the body through fasting and prostration, it burns and flees from us. In addition, if we put the cross or holy books as a shield to protect us from demons in the area where we sleep, then it will burn the demons and weaken their power, so they will disappear completely.

In the journey of life there is a fall and a rise in sin. The solution to our defilement is repentance. There is no stain of sin or crime that repentance does not wash away. Because of this, even though human beings should repent, they will never stop doing their best to prevent it from happening soon. One of the dangers of procrastination is changing the heart prepared for repentance and destroying the opportunity for repentance. If sin is not eradicated immediately, it becomes a deep-rooted addiction, and this can over time extinguish and harden the spark of repentance in our hearts. Therefore, it is necessary to confess that what we have committed is a serious sin of adultery, we hate this act of destruction from the heart, we are afraid and ashamed of it, and we vow to never return to it, let alone think about committing it in the future, and repent. text:
Many people fall into this dilemma and are heard to say, "I don't even know what's bothering me." But most of the time, when we examine the root of our anxiety, we find it to be fear. If we don't know the real cause and consequences of the problem or the situation that is making us streas, or if we are stressed without facing anything to worry about, this means that there is an evil spirit that is fighting against us. This type of problem is common among many people and we need to walk away from this mentality once we know that we are victims of this.

text.text: Therefore, by taking spiritual medicine, which means by fasting, praying, prostrating, believing, listening to the word of God, holding prayer, we silence the spirit of anxiety that has made our whole life a battlefield.

Therefore, marriage is a great mystery in which he and she will not think of anyone for love other than each other. From the day of the marriage, they will have children, share property, and live as long as God allows them.

Marriage is established mainly based on 3 purposes (pillars); These are 1. to help each other, 2. to have a childreen, 3. to be saved from adultery. The goal is to live and walk the path of righteousness as a one heart, one word, in complete unity, and togetherness.
